action.dry: Check that the irrigation runs: valve open, pump working, drippers not blocked. Water the area. If the irrigation looks fine, check that the sensor is still pushed into the soil.
action.over: Stop or shorten the irrigation. Look for pooling water, a stuck valve or a leaking pipe.
action.no_flow: Turn the pump off. Check the tank level, the pipe for kinks or a blockage, and the pump power. Restart and watch the flow.
action.leak: Close the main valve. Walk the line from the tank to the drippers and look for wet ground or a broken fitting.
action.offline: Check the node's power and that the Wi-Fi hotspot is on. Restart the board. If it still does not report, swap in the spare.
action.sensor_fault: Check the sensor cable and connector. Re-seat the soil probe. Replace the sensor if it keeps failing.
action.litter: Collect the litter in the camera's view. Add a photo when you mark the task done.
action.ndvi_drop: Walk the park and look for dry patches, damaged irrigation lines or removed plants.
action.heat_stress: Water now: the soil is dry and it is very hot, plants can be damaged within the hour. Check the valve, the pump and the drippers, and water the area by hand if needed.
action.blockage: The pump runs but too little water flows. Clean the filter, look for kinked or crushed pipes and blocked drippers, then watch the flow.
action.low_battery: Clean the solar panel and check its cable. If the battery stays low, swap it at the next visit.
action.litter_repeated: Litter keeps coming back here. Collect it now, and check whether the bins are full or missing. Add a photo when you mark the task done.

demo.title: Demo controls
demo.intro: Each button changes the simulated parks only. The real parks are never touched.
demo.notDemo: Demo mode is off. Set DEMO_MODE=true in the root .env and restart the containers.
demo.confirmResetBody: Resets only the demo story: Al Adel, forced faults, and the open alerts and tasks of the simulated parks. Healthy parks keep their state.

reset.title: Reset
reset.body: Back to the start of the story: Al Adel healthy at about 35 % (pump ready, automatic irrigation on), the other parks healthy, batteries near 100 %, alerts and tasks cleared.

dry.title: Dry soil
dry.body: Al Adel drops below its minimum: after 2 readings a high-priority dry alert appears on the map.

leak.title: Leak
leak.body: Alkhatateen shows water flowing with the pump off: an urgent leak alert within 3 readings.

offline.title: Sensor offline
offline.body: Alhilal's sensor stops reporting: after 30 seconds the park turns grey; after 2 minutes the alert is ready for a task.

recover.title: Recover
recover.body: Ends heat, leak, blockage, low battery and the offline sensor; the alerts resolve on their own.

heat.title: Heat stress
heat.body: Al Adel's temperature rises to about 42 °C: the open dry alert turns into heat stress (urgent) within one reading, with no second alert.

blockage.title: Blockage
blockage.body: While Al Adel's pump is on, its flow drops to about a third of expected: a high-priority blockage alert after 3 readings (field version, simulated parks only).

battery.title: Low battery
battery.body: Al Adel's simulated battery drops to 15 %: a low-priority low battery alert after 2 readings (field version, simulated parks only).

escalate.title: Escalate
escalate.body: The newest open, not started task reaches its due time now: within 10 seconds its priority goes up (or it is flagged overdue) and you get a notice.

litter.title: Litter
litter.body: Sim Cam on Al Adel Park (a simulated camera) sends the litter sample photos: after 2 frames a litter alert appears; after 3 episodes or 5+ items it becomes repeated litter (high).

demo.confirmFullResetTitle: Full reset of all simulated parks?
demo.confirmFullResetBody: Every simulated park goes back to its starting state: soil, irrigation, pump, batteries, alerts and tasks. History is kept. Use it only before a fresh run.
demo.fullResetHint: Full reset also restores the healthy parks to their start.

reset.title: Reset
reset.watch: Overview: every park is healthy, Al Adel is at about 35 % with automatic irrigation on, no open alerts or tasks. Nothing happens until you press Step 1.

dry.title: Dry soil, fixed automatically
dry.story: Press the button and Al Adel's soil drops below its minimum: a dry alert appears, the pump starts by itself, moisture climbs to the target, the pump stops and the fix is verified. No human needed.
dry.watch: Overview (the alert and the live moisture), then Al Adel's page for the pump.

leak.title: A leak, a worker is needed
leak.story: The pump can't fix a broken pipe. Create the task, the worker's phone beeps, he repairs it and taps Done, and the sensors verify it.
leak.watch: Overview for the urgent alert, Tasks to create and follow the task, then the worker's phone.

litter.title: Litter, the camera sends a cleaner
litter.story: Litter in 2 frames: alert, task, cleaner, clean frames, verified.
litter.watch: Overview for the litter alert, Tasks for the task, the worker's phone for the photo. Send frames with the camera below.

heat.title: Heat
heat.story: Al Adel's temperature rises to about 42 °C.
heat.watch: Overview: the dry alert becomes heat stress (urgent).
heat.ends: Stays open until you run Recover or the park cools down.

blockage.title: Blockage
blockage.story: While the pump is on, Al Adel's flow drops to a third of expected.
blockage.watch: Overview: a high-priority blockage alert after 3 readings.
blockage.ends: Needs a worker to clean the filter; Recover clears it.

battery.title: Battery
battery.story: Al Adel's simulated battery drops to 15 %.
battery.watch: Overview: a low-priority low battery alert after 2 readings.
battery.ends: Recover restores the battery and resolves the alert.

offline.title: Sensor offline
offline.watch: The map: the park turns grey after 30 seconds; Overview: the alert is ready after 2 minutes.
offline.ends: Recover brings the sensor back and the alert resolves.

escalate.title: Escalate
escalate.story: The newest open task that has not started reaches its due time.
escalate.watch: Tasks: within 10 seconds its priority rises or it is flagged overdue, and a notice appears.
escalate.ends: The task stays open until a worker starts it.

recover.title: Recover
recover.story: Ends heat, leak, blockage, low battery and the offline sensor.
recover.watch: Overview: those alerts resolve on their own.
recover.ends: The parks go back to healthy.

ndvi.title: Fetch satellite data
ndvi.story: Pulls the latest Sentinel-2 greenness (NDVI) for the parks.
ndvi.watch: A park page: the NDVI chart and the map layer.
ndvi.ends: The new values are saved and shown on the map.

full.story: Puts every simulated park back to its starting state: soil, irrigation, pump, batteries, alerts and tasks.
full.watch: Overview: everything is clean and healthy.
full.ends: History is kept. Use it only before a fresh run.
